workDescription: Designed a new website for Midwest Radiology, one of the largest Radiology centers in St. Paul Minnesota. The website was built in Statamic v2. Some of the cool features includes a searchable directory of physicians, that gets used almost everyday according to Google Analytics and an interactive map that shows other radiology centers in Minnesota. I had a lot of fun building out the  mega menu. I've also helped increase their search presence through SEO and manage their news blog.
